purpose: Amendment sought to eliminate the account for Overseas Humanitarian, Disaster, and Civic Aid.
description: An amendment numbered 111 printed in Part A of House Report 119-199 to reduce funding for "overseas humanitarian, disaster, and civic aid" to be in line with the administration's budget request, and transfer the savings to the Spending Reduction Account.
